The measured before/after (14→7 of 66, and the 14 were accidental prose self-mentions, never a feature) confirms the gap is structural, exposed rather than created by the module-body narrowing.

Deliverable per the card's own direction: in `derive()`, treat each of `entry.files` as a watch hint for its own family (provenance = the file path itself); self-test pins both directions (a gate script derives its own family; an unrelated script does not; the thin-gate-file specimen keeps working). Derived-never-listed preserved — `entry.files` is already runtime-resolved from package.json.

Serial: same file as the in-flight watch-hint PR — dispatches after it lands, premise re-derived on the merged ref (expect the 7-of-66 number as the red baseline). Size S–M, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus`.
